sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS The net proceeds from any disposition of the
Shares will be received by the selling stockholders. We will not receive any of the proceeds from any such Shares offered by this prospectus.
We will, however, receive the net proceeds of any Warrants exercised for cash. We expect to use the proceeds received from the exercise
of the Warrants, if any, for general working capital purposes. There are no contractual restrictions requiring proceeds received by the
